Moz Pro: the all-in-one SEO and AI search toolkit

Moz Pro is the do-it-all SEO solution to help you rank higher, drive qualified traffic, and measure your brand’s presence in AI-generated answers.

Explore Moz Pro
Keyword Research

Discover thousands of keywords to target along with Keyword Difficulty scores, accurate search volumes, and SERP analysis.

Learn more
Competitive Research

Identify competitors, keyword gaps, and link opportunities to improve organic share of voice, benchmark your presence in AI-generated answers, and outmaneuver the competition.

Learn more
Link Research

Get insight into any website’s authority and link profile in seconds, including linking domains, most valuable pages, anchor text, and Domain Authority.

Learn more
Rank Tracking

Track the performance of hundreds (or thousands) of keywords across 170+ search engines.

Learn more
Domain Overview

Get a quick SEO snapshot dashboard for any domain. Gain measurable insight with metrics like Brand Authority and Domain Authority, along with ranking keywords and top backlinks.

Learn more
Site Crawl

Audit your site to find and diagnose technical SEO issues that may hurt your organic search rankings. Make sure your site is optimized with actionable recommendations.

Learn more
Explore Moz Pro

STAT: the ultimate large-scale rank tracking platform

Whether you’re juggling multiple sites, millions of pages, or just a ton of keywords, STAT helps you unlock new opportunities, drive more revenue, and prove the value of your SEO efforts.

  • Daily analytics at scale

  • Get everything the 100-result SERP has to offer (plus its full HTML) in any location, on desktop and mobile, every day, for keyword counts that start in the thousands.

  • Market visibility

  • Outrank rivals and grow your market presence with powerful share of voice metrics and robust competitor tracking. Know who you’re up against and how you compare.

  • SERP feature insights

  • See exactly which SERP features appear in your space, and how much visibility they drive, so you can create the right content for the right keywords.

  • Customizable segments
  • Understand your data from any angle. Group keywords into custom segments – no matter how granular – to surface precision insights for data-driven decisions.
  • Flexible reporting

  • Take your SERP data to go with one-click CSV reports, handy APIs, and pre-built Looker Studio connectors to fuel deep analysis and ambitious experimentation.

Explore STAT

Moz Local: the local SEO and reputation management tool

Whether you have one location or 10,000, manage business listings and reviews, report on performance and sentiment, and post to social media all from one easy-to-use platform.

  • Business listings management
  • Seamlessly create and manage your local business listings on Google, Facebook, and other relevant directories to help consumers find and choose your business(es) directly from Moz Local.
  • Review management
  • Monitor, read, and respond to customer reviews on multiple sites from a single dashboard.
  • Easily share news and offers

  • Engage your audience and customers online with business news and promotional updates via directories and social platforms.

  • Monitor and report on performance

  • Show off your results with ease. Share the Visibility Index, sentiment, and online presence score reports with your teams and clients to keep them up to speed on current performance. Managed clients also benefit from advanced analytics and API access.

Explore Moz Local

Moz API: powering custom data solutions

Moz’s proprietary metrics have helped shape the SEO industry since 2004. Plug into the Moz API to build or enhance your custom data tools and dashboards.

  • Domain Authority
  • Predict the ranking power of link signals to a website with the original authority metric developed by Moz. Often imitated, never replicated.
  • Page Authority
  • Predict how well a specific page will rank in search results based on linking factors.
  • Brand Authority
  • Measure brand strength at scale for thousands of sites at a time with Brand Authority, a revolutionary metric that measures a website’s brand strength on a scale of one to 100.
  • Spam Score

  • Assess the level of risk of links from specific subdomains with Spam Score, a Moz metric that represents the percentage of sites with similar features that have been penalized or banned by Google.

  • In-depth link data
  • Understand the competitive landscape and power your link-building campaigns by accessing detailed link counts, link propensity scores, anchor text strings, and inbound links to a page.
